'''''Attalea cohune''''', commonly known as the '''cohune palm''' (also '''rain tree''', '''American oil palm''', '''corozo palm''' or '''manaca palm'''),<ref>[http://www.floridata.com/ref/A/atta_coh.cfm Cohune palm at Floridata]</ref> is a species of [[Arecaceae|palm tree]] native to [[Mexico]] and parts of [[Central America]].<ref>{{GRIN | accessdate=2009-01-28}}</ref>

The cohune palm is used in the production of [[cohune oil]] and its nut can be used as a variety of [[vegetable ivory]].

==Example occurrences==
A chief occurrence as a dominant plant is in the [[Belizean pine forests]] ecoregion.<ref>C. Michael Hogan & World Wildlife Fund. 2012.
